Facts: The property is not conveniently divisible in kind. Legal framework: Judicial partition – equalization (Articles 720 and 726 of the Italian Civil Code).
Issue: The manner in which the division must be carried out. Principle: Where the asset is indivisible, joint assignment is lawful, with the adjustment of the parties’ respective positions through monetary equalization payments.
